body: Offline speech recognition API for Android, iOS, Raspberry Pi and servers with Python, Java, C# and Node
plain_description: **Add offline speech recognition to your products and workflows.** Transcribe speech in 20+ languages, create subtitles, and identify speakers. Runs on devices from smartphones and Raspberry Pi to server clusters.
technical_description: An open source offline speech recognition toolkit with models around 50 MB, continuous large-vocabulary transcription, streaming responses, configurable vocabulary, and speaker identification. Provides bindings for Python, Java, Node.js, C#, C++, Rust, Go, and other languages, and supports Android, iOS, Raspberry Pi, and servers.
title: Vosk Speech Recognition Toolkit
